_comment: Rounding scale in CSS pixels at 1x. Every generator and config snippet reads from here. widget and menu_item follow the Mystical Blue Kvantum style, which draws its own tiles; they are recorded here for reference, not applied by a generator.

frame.note: 20 px on the Rounded Corners effect for every window; the Klassy decoration draws square and never rounds, so the effect owns the corner and the hairline from one path. One bright 1 px light hairline on the edge. No border, no inset.

titlebar_buttons.hover: icon colour only: traffic-light colours, muted toward the titlebar at rest and full on hover
